hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The maximum Hamming distance between x and any number in nums equals m minus the minimum Hamming distance from the bitwise complement of x to nums.

hints.title: Hypercube Distance
hints.text: Represent all 2^m bit combinations as vertices in a hypercube graph where edges connect numbers differing in exactly one bit position.

hints.title: Multi-Source Traversal
hints.text: Run a multi-source BFS starting from all numbers present in nums to find the shortest distance to each state. Return m - dist[x ^ ((1 << m) - 1)].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth-first search traversing m * 2^m edges across hypercube.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs comparison takes O(n^2 * m) time, which exceeds limits for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(2^m) array for hypercube shortest distances.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that maximum distance to a set corresponds to minimum distance from the bitwise complement in a hypercube graph.
